subject: Request: short trial extension + surge coverage / conditional rebate
messages:
From: Anika Sharma <anika@brightbridge.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@brightbridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Short trial extension + surge coverage request

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding and the dedicated warmup last week — the BrightBridge team made good progress. We ran into an unexpected data ingestion surge over the past 48 hours that burned through our initial trial bucket. Our engineers (Tom cc'd) will need ~2 weeks more to stabilize the pipeline and validate the model under production load.

Can Redwood provide a short trial extension (14 days) and either:
- a small one-time top-up for the current trial bucket (we used ~420k tokens, estimate ~350k more for validation), or
- a surge-coverage arrangement where Redwood covers overage and BrightBridge receives a conditional rebate if the additional usage doesn't exceed 2x our current burn rate.

I've attached the updated SOW that calls out the new test scenarios. We're under a tight calendar to show performance by June 30. If you can share options + rough pricing by EOD tomorrow, we can route for approval.

Appreciate it —
Anika
Product Ops, BrightBridge
attachments: BrightBridge_SOW_v2.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Anika Sharma <anika@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@brightbridge.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 18:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short trial extension + surge coverage request

Hi Anika — thanks for the context and the SOW. Quick options we can offer today so you can move forward:

1) Short top-up: one-time 300k token add-on to your trial for $750 (applied as a credit to the trial account). No contract amendment required.

2) Conditional rebate (preferred if you expect variable surge): Redwood will front the overage for up to 2x your current burn rate for the 14-day extension and BrightBridge gets a rebate equal to 30% of billed overage if aggregate daily burn during the extension remains below 2x the baseline. Cap: rebate limited to $3,000. Requires a short amendment.

3) Bridging invoice: If you prefer guaranteed capacity, we can provision a temporary dedicated top-up instance for 14 days at a fixed $2,200 fee (higher up-front but guarantees throughput).

Operational notes: we can route the amendment for finance and legal within 24 hours for options 2/3. For option 1 we can cut the credit now and extend the trial expiry date.

Which would you prefer? If option 2, we'll prepare a one-page amendment and a DocuSign link; if option 1, I'll apply the credit now.

—Vanessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: (none)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Short trial extension + surge coverage request (finance/legal check)

Looping finance/legal for approval. Quick internal summary:
- Option 1 (300k credit) is fast, low-friction. No legal required. Finance concurs.
- Option 2 (conditional rebate) needs a short AMEND and a hard cap on liability (recommend $3k cap as Vanessa suggested). Legal asks for clear measurement window and definition of "baseline burn" in the amendment.
- Option 3 (dedicated bridging instance) needs Ops coordination; procurement will require a PO.

Marcus — can you confirm we can apply the rebate accounting treatment as a credit memo if triggered? Also attaching a draft amendment (proposed_amendment_draft.docx) with suggested language for baseline and rebate calculation. If everyone signs off, I'll generate a DocuSign and the HubSpot amendment record.

Thanks,
Lauren
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed_amendment_draft.docx

From: Anika Sharma <anika@brightbridge.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short trial extension + surge coverage request

Hi Vanessa / Lauren — thanks for the clear options. BrightBridge will take Option 2 (conditional rebate) provided:
- The amendment defines baseline as the average daily token burn from Jun 1–Jun 7.
- The rebate cap is $3,000 and the measurement window is the 14-day extension period.
- Security can confirm that audit logs for requests are retained for 90 days (our compliance team requested evidence).

Please route the amendment to legal and security; Tom and I will prioritize review on our side. If we can get the DocuSign today, we should be able to proceed and keep the June 30 milestone.

I appreciate the flexibility —
Anika
Product Ops, BrightBridge
attachments: (none)
